title: Indonesian SaaS and business social-post observations
method: Eight purposively selected public posts, inspected through a newly launched Playwright Chromium headless browser with a new anonymous context. No personal browser, account, cookies, or credentials used. No interactions published.
limitations: Convenience sample: one Indonesian SaaS founder, one technical/SaaS-interest account, and one Indonesian business software brand.
Counts are live-page snapshots, not lifetime outcomes, unique people, conversions, or causal effects. Threads Comment counts are recorded as replies and can include author and nested replies.
Views on Threads and Instagram follower count are rounded display strings. No engagement rates calculated.
Blank public count labels mean not visible, never zero. Instagram zeros below were explicitly stated by public og:description and corroborated by No comments yet.
Instagram dates can differ between visible label, public metadata and machine-readable UTC timestamp. Both are retained where observed.
Post age, topic, media format, amplification, existing audience and offer differ. Paid reach, saves, unique reach, profile visits, clickthrough and conversions are unknown.
Captions and public replies were inspected; Instagram carousel images and Reel videos were not fully reviewed. Content type is a researcher classification of the caption only.
Intura was used only to discover two canonical Threads URLs. Its aggregate counts and conclusions were excluded.

profiles.description: Public bio describes entrepreneur, lecturer and IT consultant.
